title: Chief Executive Officer and Energy Consultant at Atem Sees Significant Opportunity for SMRs, While First-of-a-Kind Costs and Timelines Remain Uncertain
expert: CEO of energy consultancy Atem; former GE Hitachi and Westinghouse nuclear engineer (20+ yrs)
verdict: A former GE Hitachi engineer ranks the BWRX-300 first among SMRs, with construction in less than four years and COD in less than five, versus seven to eight years for Rolls-Royce and Holtec; first-of-a-kind cost overruns of 5X or 10X are the main risk.
thesis_impact: Tenet 4 (hyperscaler broadening): → — about 25 GW of data-center demand is the expert's estimate and not tied to GEV orders.
Tenets 1–3, 5, 6: not addressed (call covers nuclear only).
